title: Two Possible Guard Loop Outcomes
statement: Let $g$ be a function on bit strings and let $W$ be a bit string. Write $\langle a,b\rangle$ for the pairing of bit strings, and let $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$ be the total projections that return the empty string when parsing fails. The result of the guard loop on $W$ is either the fixed completed-block encoding, or the encoding whose first component is $\pi_1(W)$ and whose second component pairs the tail of $\pi_1(\pi_2(W))$ with the result of applying the guarded next-state function to $\pi_1(W)$ and $\pi_2(\pi_2(W))$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $g$ from bit strings to bit strings
